chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding a man who died and left behind a small child for whom a wet nurse was sought.
That the payment for the child's breastfeeding is to be taken from what he inherits from his father and his mother.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ وَ أُمِّهِ: his father and his mother, from whose estate he inherits
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.اسْتُرْضِعَ: a wet nurse was sought or breastfeeding was arranged
key_terms.قَضَى: ruled or issued a judicial decision

ai.seo_question: From whose wealth should the payment for breastfeeding an orphaned child be taken?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the expense of breastfeeding a child after the father's death. It states that the wage for nursing the child is paid from the child's inherited wealth from his father and mother, showing the child's financial rights and maintenance are tied to his estate.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4685 - The Commander of the Faithful (as), ruled regarding a man who passed away and left behind a child who needed to be breastfed:
"The
payment for the child's breastfeeding should be taken from what the child inherits from his father and mother."
